selection: Existing motorless_primary rows, with unchanged window, event and BHA identifiers

original.numerical_treatment: D6 occupancy-weighted original thermal pieces and D7 mesh confined to physical well ends; v1.5.0 equations

working_entry10.rheology: no-yield power law through the reported 600/300 rpm readings

secondary_entry8.rheology: no-yield power law through the reported 600/300 rpm readings

surface_loss_uncertainty: unquantified installed layout; API case 5 is a transferred scenario
tool_loss_uncertainty: additional jar/shock operating losses unquantified; no numerical tool band

fluid_system.basis: Figure 14 BHA dates and section 6.3.5 planned polymer system; actual continuity is an assumption
fluid_system.mud_rule: Nearest recorded density and paired PV/YP within these dates, in either direction; earlier breaks ties

target_reduction.unit: psi, DDR convention; raw header is a generic source unit
target_reduction.window_statistic: Equal-weight mean of the six native-pressure bin means

metric.event_statistic: Median prediction and median observation on identical paired windows; subtract medians
metric.RMSE_weighting: Equal event weights on the same jointly converged, target-complete cohort

source_gaps: Installed ordinary-pipe OD, weight, bore and connection machining are not confirmed; catalogue scenarios are assumptions.
Internal connection shape and effective restricted length remain unmeasured.
Nominal polymer-fluid continuity and density test temperature remain assumptions.
Unknown proprietary jar/shock and actual surface-line losses have no finite sourced band.
Rotary string heat is omitted because no independent off-bottom torque input has been supplied.

model_only_budget.windows: All 62 registered windows; every model solved independently
model_only_budget.event_reduction: Arithmetic mean of each pressure part and total across the same successful windows in all three models; median total also reported
model_only_budget.skill_reduction_unchanged: Event medians on identical target-complete jointly converged windows; equal event weights
model_only_budget.missing_tool_losses: No additional jar, shock-sub or other unsourced operating loss in any calculation

starting_profile_check.method: Original solve(init=converged working profile) against independently seeded original on every window; identical original equations and inputs
